units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 8:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VIII, 5</cite> two feet &c. of a bed cut off <he>א׳</he> crosswise; (<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 18:5">Kel. XVIII, 5</cite> <cite ref="L00265"><he>לוכסן</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: אֲלַכְסוֹן, ch. form אֲלַכְסוֹנָא m. diagonal line, diameter.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 101b">B. Bath. 101ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 8a:4">Succ. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>כל אמתא … באלכסונָהּ</he> a figure of one square cubit has a diagonal line of 1<sup>2</sup>/<sub>5</sub> cubits (approximately).

<cite ref="Menachot 35a">Men. 35ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 24b">Meg. 24ᵇ</cite> must be square <he>בתפרן ובאֲלַכְסוֹנָן</he> both as to their seams (not warped) and as to the measure of their diagonal lines.
<cite ref="Eruvin 59a">Erub. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>מידת העיר ואלכסונָהּ</he> Ms. K. (ed. <he>בא׳</he>, v. Rashi a. l.) the measure of the circumference of the town plus its diameter.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 99a:4">B. Bath. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>ודילמא בא׳ הוו קיימי</he> perhaps the Cherubim in the Sanctuary were placed across the room; a. fr.
